_UrlsNote: HyMotion Local is hosted by the gym server on port 7140. It listens on the server's LAN interfaces so other gym PCs can open http://<server-ip>:7140. SQL Server remains on the server; do not expose its port to the LAN.

DatabaseConfig.Description: Local SQL Server Express. Default instance name '.\SQLEXPRESS' below is a fallback for a fresh Express install only — the installer/setup script should write the actual discovered instance's connection string to %ProgramData%\HyMotion\config\appsettings.json (see LocalRuntimePaths.ConfigOverrideFile), which overrides this value without editing this file.

_LicenseNote: PublicKeyPem is safe to ship (it cannot forge a license). LicenseServer:BaseUrl is the platform API origin shipped with this kit, not the console site. A gym can still override it via %ProgramData%\HyMotion\config\appsettings.json, HYMOTION_LICENSE_SERVER_URL, or license-server.url next to GMS.Api.exe.
_SecretsNote: JwtSettings:SecretKey, EncryptionKey, MemberAppActivation:CodePepper and EmployeeAppActivation:CodePepper are deliberately left unset here (same convention as appsettings.Production.json) — the app fails closed rather than falling back to a shared/default key when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Local. Supply unique per-install values via environment variables or user-secrets until the installer's secret-generation step exists (Phase 2+).
